_readme: Live settings, edit on GitHub to change behaviour without touching code (takes up to ~10 min to apply). bots.maxPerRoom: 0 turns fill-in racers off. busyRoomsHalf/busyRoomsOff: how many other busy public rooms before bots drop to 1 / 0. publicSlots: how many public rooms quick match checks at a time; when they're all full it opens the next batch automatically (up to 120 rooms). peer: optional self-hosted PeerJS server, e.g. {"host": "peer.example.com", "port": 443, "path": "/", "secure": true} (also add it to the CSP in index.html). analytics.posthogKey: paste your PostHog project API key (phc_...) to switch on anonymous analytics; use https://eu.i.posthog.com as posthogHost for an EU project. lobby: public rooms start readyGoMs after most players are ready, or at the latest soloWaitMs (one real player) / groupWaitMs (2+) after a second player arrives; minAfterJoinMs is the minimum time left whenever someone joins; resultsMs is how long results stay up between rounds. turn: relay for players on networks that block direct connections (work/school Wi-Fi). turn.credentialsUrl is our Cloudflare Worker that hands out short-lived Cloudflare relay logins (main relay); turn.iceServers holds the Metered relay logins as a backup (public by design: every player's browser needs them; restrict allowed domains in the Metered dashboard).
